newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO CETES RATE DROPS AS PLAYERS SHED LIQUIDITY.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO CETES RATE DROPS AS PLAYERS SHED LIQUIDITY.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates on Wednesday ended down 230 basis points at 16.50 percent.
Dealers said an early slide in tandem with U.S. long bond yields gathered pace when players with heavy liquidity positions stepped in to buy at the close.
The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond was 19/32 higher in late dealing, with the yield dropping to yield 6.63 percent.
Traders said a strong peso also helped push Mexican rates lower. Benchmark 48-hour contracts ended 0.8 centavo firmer at 7.7760/7.7790 per dollar.
